title: Recent changes
summary: The latest player-facing changes reflected in this guide.
body:
October 9, 2026

  • 48 Classic reward zones and 384 obtainable item variants added to the wiki.
  • Zone hunt, type-22 augments and three-copy forging are installed for live testing.
  • Passive AA rewards increased to 40%, alongside full leveling experience.
  • Always Loot / Never Loot row controls and automatic closing of a confirmed empty queue are published.
  • Throw Stone now directly adds effective Spell Damage.
  • Spell gems persist through normal death; player checks remain open.

Earlier releases

Current guides also cover universal trading, multiple pets and stored armor, the tunnel hub, travel and launcher updates.

Release labels describe availability, not completed gameplay acceptance. See In development for unreleased candidates.
